title: Review recipe detail sheet implementation
description: Review all implementation and test beads against the spec and ui-guidelines.md. Check: scaling math correctness for all factors and edge cases; stat hiding logic; hero image fallback shape and size invariant; gradient/title overlay legibility; dismiss button and bottom-bar button accessibility labels; alert wording (must not claim success); correct security-scoped resource start/stop in RecipeImageLoader; step combiner item-resolution correctness; Dynamic Type compliance; no custom colours or controls; xcodegen ran and build passes; all three test files exist and cover specified cases.
acceptance_criteria: Scaling math matches spec for all four factors including fractional and whole-number formatting.
All five stats hidden correctly when metadata keys are absent.
Hero image fallback is a fixed-height block with fork.knife symbol — same dimensions as image case.
Dismiss button has accessibility label; bottom-bar buttons have accessibility labels.
Alert wording does not imply success.
No custom colours, custom controls, or hardcoded font sizes introduced.
startAccessingSecurityScopedResource / stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource called correctly in all paths.
All three unit-test files exist and all tests pass.
xcodegen generate was run and the build succeeds.
